# rustinion_snmp_target (Resource)

Manages an SNMP target: a switch, router, printer or UPS that a group's agents poll over SNMP (v2c or v3), the same as Monitoring -> SNMP targets in the admin UI.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group whose agents poll the target. Changing it recreates the target.
- `host` (String) Hostname or IP address the agents poll.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `community` (String, Sensitive) SNMPv2c community string. Write-only: stored encrypted and never returned by the API, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected (see the matching `has_*` attribute).
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `poll_interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between polls, at least 30. Default 300.
- `port` (Number)
- `v3_auth_key` (String, Sensitive) SNMPv3 authentication key. Write-only: stored encrypted and never returned by the API, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected (see the matching `has_*` attribute).
- `v3_auth_protocol` (String) SNMPv3 authentication protocol: `sha1` or `sha2`.
- `v3_priv_key` (String, Sensitive) SNMPv3 privacy key. Write-only: stored encrypted and never returned by the API, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected (see the matching `has_*` attribute).
- `v3_priv_protocol` (String) SNMPv3 privacy protocol: `des`, `aes128`, `aes192` or `aes256`.
- `v3_username` (String) SNMPv3 user name (required for `version = "v3"`).
- `version` (String) `v2c` (default) or `v3`.

### Read-Only

- `has_community` (Boolean) Whether the server holds a community string.
- `has_v3_auth_key` (Boolean)
- `has_v3_priv_key` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
